Dependency authority and closure status for v0.2.15
=================================================
alchemy_foreign_object_v0.2
  Shared authoritative foreign-object base. A pinned deployment copy is present.

alchemy_objects_v0.8
  AlchemyObject.cls, AlchemySecurity.cls, AlchemyLockedMethod.cls and AlchemyEvidence.cls.
  These remain the pinned object-base dependency inherited from the qualified v0.2.14 line.

Inspector Clouseau v0.8.1 repaired authority
  REQUIRED by the Inspector/concurrency qualification.
  Exact authority package: alchemy_objects_v0.8.1-inspector-repaired.zip
  SHA-256: fcb299f27aa3226a7a0ff2a98b5f681286e1dd61ea634e955f87d88ec5bdad3a
  Expected package path: dependencies/alchemy_objects_v0.8.1/inspector/InspectorClouseau.cls
  Do not silently substitute the older v0.8 Inspector.

oorexx_logging_v0.7
  MethodInterposition.cls supplies the shared cooperative interposition coordinator.

oorexx_runtime_support
  crypto.cls/json.cls are runtime support dependencies. test.sh verifies both before building.

CLOSURE RULE
  A delivery is self-contained only when every path preflighted by test.sh is physically present.
  An authority note or checksum is not a substitute for the dependency bytes. Missing closure is
  a packaging failure and must be reported as such; it must never be converted into a test PASS.

Library review 2026-10-07
  The current Project Alchemy Component Register does not yet list .NET Alchemy.
  The Library also contains a newer standalone/general-purpose Inspector Clouseau line. It is not
  substituted here because v0.2.14/v0.2.15 specifically qualify the repaired v0.8.1 cooperative
  interposition contract. Adoption of the standalone Inspector is a separate compatibility task.
